expected.error_message: Could not remove existing world folders.

notes: replaceWorld validates the new source first (ZIP openable, or folder exists -- lines 60-76) and takes the optional safety backup (lines 78-85) before ever touching the current world. The removal step (lines 101-112) is a separate, later gate: 'guard removed else { ...; return false }' at lines 114-118 exits before the switch that extracts/copies the replacement source (lines 120-137) ever runs. So an injected removal failure -- the 'delete' side of the rename/copy/delete/extract failure set -- leaves both the old world (removal never completed) and server.properties (never reached) untouched; nothing is left half-replaced.
